_comment: FROZEN expected-outcome baseline for the L3 fast-subset test. L3 validates batch scheduling + failure-handler retry: Stage 4 must fire at least once (STG-1), retry budget must be enforced (STG-2), and no terminal retriable_error state (STG-3). terminal_state_distribution is a soft calibration — only pending==0 is hard; the passed/failed/ignored split depends on remote cache state. AF and INV are intentionally absent (L3 is linear, not Kanban).

terminal_state_distribution._note: Only pending==0 is enforced — the passed/failed/ignored split depends on remote model cache. STG-1/2/3 provide the real behavioral assertions.

stage_invariants.rule: failure-handler fired at least once (retry path exercised)
stage_invariants.check: manifest.json contains >=1 entry with retry_count > 0, or batch_results.json has >=1 entry with final_status == retriable_error in a trajectory
stage_invariants.rationale: L3 fixture uses l3_fast_subset which includes tests that may fail on the offline remote; if no test ever triggers the failure-handler, Stage 4 was bypassed and the chain is incomplete

stage_invariants.rule: max_retry boundary enforced — no test executed more than max_retry + 1 times
stage_invariants.check: for each manifest entry: retry_count <= config.max_retry_per_test (2 for L3)
stage_invariants.rationale: Defends failure-handler.py boundary bug; retry budget must be honored

stage_invariants.rule: retriable_error is a non-terminal transient state — must transition to ignored/passed/failed by end of run
stage_invariants.check: no manifest terminal entry has status == retriable_error (must be promoted to ignored at max_retry, or to passed/failed on success)
stage_invariants.rationale: Catch 'transient state never promoted' bugs that would leave the supervisor confused

must_all_hold: STG-1: failure-handler triggered at least once
STG-2: no test exceeds retry budget
